name: America's Most Eligible
source:
Battle it out in a reality TV show to determine who is most eligible! Create alliances, make enemies, even fall in love... the choice is up to you!

[From [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/America%27s_Most_Eligible:_Season_10]Choices Wikia[/url]]
translation:
在真人秀节目中一决高下，决定谁最有资格！结盟、树敌、甚至坠入爱河……选择权在你！
